purpose: Pin the TollGate interop surface as data: canonical token fixtures with per-stage lifecycle verdicts, and HTTP endpoint request/response vectors. Every TollGate consumer (portal decoder, Go wallet, Rust wallet, test minters, client implementations) must produce the recorded verdicts for these inputs; a divergence is a filed bug against this repo, not a field incident.

local_v1_mint.determinism: seeded with the all-zeros BIP39 test mnemonic (public test vector, not a secret); same config + mnemonic reproduces the keyset

reference_environment.minter: cdk-cli 0.18.0 (CDK reference; Nutshell 0.21.0 secondary — the V1-era fixtures are Nutshell-minted against the local V1 mint)
reference_environment.notes: Verdicts cited as live were captured against these targets on 2026-10-16; the rig was in degraded mode (no reachable mints) for part of the capture, which is itself a pinned mode (TIP-01 degraded mode).

kg_state.definition: cdk-cli 0.18.1 (CDK primary reference) minted tokens on V2 keysets, NUT-00 V4 (primary, newest) + V3 (current), accepted end-to-end by the reference backend (1022; degraded refusal must not consume proofs) and received cleanly by the CDK reference wallet

open_gaps.note: portal MAIN is green on the KG set (probed 2026-10-16; regression lock portal#83) — the gap is the stale deployed pin, i.e. release/deploy work

kg_state.backwards_compatibility: OUT OF SCOPE for this pin — V1-keyset era and older-wallet behavior is deferred to compat-era/ and is layered on only after this state is green across every consumer

lifecycle_stages.decode: parse the token string offline into a token structure
lifecycle_stages.verify: offline field/keyset validation before any network call
lifecycle_stages.checkstate: NUT-07 POST /v1/checkstate at the mint that minted the proofs
lifecycle_stages.spend: submit as payment to a TollGate (HTTP-01 POST /) or wallet Receive

vocabularies.no_verdict_hang_note: consumer does not terminate on the input. Observed on cdk-cli 0.18.1 decode-token: with a COLD wallet (no cached keysets) it deadlocks silently — single sleeping thread, no I/O — on tokens whose keyset id cannot resolve from wallet state (V3 with a truncated id whose mint is not registered; Nutshell-minted V1-era tokens whose mint is not registered). With the mint's keysets cached (reference configuration) the truncated-id V3 token decodes. A hang is not a verdict: runners MUST apply a timeout and report no-verdict-hang, and the shape is a candidate upstream bug to file against the consumer

assertion_matchers.regex: ECMA-262 regex, fully anchored by the consumer
assertion_matchers.nostr-pubkey: 64 hex chars (32-byte x-only); MUST NOT be a MAC or any other non-pubkey value

known_divergences.summary: Deployed portal pin rejects every V2-keyset token at its client-side keyset check (CU109 card), never submits; broke browser e-cash payments on 4 of 6 default mints. Portal MAIN already decodes all corpus shapes (probed through the real decoder 2026-10-16); regression lock landed as portal#83. The divergence is now release/deploy work: refresh the pin.

Reference backend (origin/main @ 27baf22) emits the customer MAC in the p tag of kind-1022 session events and addressed kind-21023 notices. Spec (tollgate#26): p is optional and MUST be a Nostr pubkey when present, never a device identifier. Session path fixed in tmbg PR #951 (open at capture time); notice path is tmbg#950.
